== Notes ==
* After being destroyed or used in a recipe, [[Salmon of Knowledge Backpiece Remnant]] with the same Mystic Forge functionality can be bought from [[Kodan Landspeaker (Renown Heart NPC)#vendor10|Kodan Landspeaker]].
* This item's description was updated from "This back item is used for crafting Janthir Wilds legendaries. Further copies can be purchased in the near future." with the [[Game updates/2025-06-24|June 24, 2025 game update]].

== Trivia ==
* The [[w:Salmon of Knowledge|Salmon of Knowledge]] is a reference to the legend of [[w:Fionn mac Cumhaill|Fionn mac Cumhaill]].
